import 'dart:math' as math;

// CASE dart_helper_items_op_width expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  Future<R> Function(T item) operation,
  int width,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_third_one expect=fire
Future<void> thirdOne(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) save) async {
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, save, 1);
}

// CASE dart_third_min_one expect=fire
Future<void> thirdMinOne(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) save) async {
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, save, math.min(1, items.length));
}

// CASE dart_third_local_one expect=fire
Future<void> thirdLocalOne(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) save) async {
  const width = 1;
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, save, width);
}

// CASE dart_third_four expect=pass
Future<void> thirdFour(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) save) async {
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, save, 4);
}

// CASE dart_second_local_min expect=fire
Future<void> secondLocalMin(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) save, int n) async {
  final width = math.min(1, n);
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save);
}
